entries.title: Provisioner cannot find package
entries.root_cause: The image provisioner requests the nonexistent package retort-metrics-agent from the configured apt repositories. The package name in the provisioning script must be corrected.

entries.title: Base image tag does not exist
entries.root_cause: The Packer Docker source selects a nonexistent Ubuntu image tag. The source image tag must be corrected.

entries.title: Provisioner script path is missing
entries.root_cause: The Packer template references a shell provisioner script that is absent from the checkout. The script path in the template must be corrected.
